steps.npc: Nilsal, and welcome to Nemus Retreat. Can I get you a drink?
Like I said, this is Nemus Retreat. Back during the War of Betrayal, this was a military camp for Imafore's army, run by none other than General Nemus himself!
General Nemus is something of a hero in these parts. Towards the end of the war, the forces of Kourend had mostly taken the Auburn Valley.
As a result, Imafore ordered General Nemus to burn the entire valley to the ground to stop the Kourend advance. Many would have died on both sides, but Nemus refused the order.
Imafore had him executed as a traitor, but in doing so he lost the support of all of Nemus' troops.

steps.player: Sounds like a bit of a shortsighted decision.

steps.npc: Indeed. Imafore presumably hoped to make an example of Nemus, but instead his decision was one of the final mistakes that ultimately led to his defeat a few months later.

Anyway, ever since the war ended, this place has remained here as something of a monument to Nemus. Of course, rather than a military camp, it now acts as a nice stop off for travellers such as yourself.
And on that note, can I get you a drink?
